data.text: Patent grants to Australian residents in 2017 fell by 17 per cent compared to 2016 and now make up just five per cent of the total. The majority of grants went to non-residents, although these also dropped 3.4 per cent from last year (Table 1). Given the inevitable lag between a patent application and a grant, it is not surprising that grants fell in 2017, because resident applications fell by about 35 per cent in 2014. Non-resident applications also fell in 2014, by 10 per cent.
